text:
- **Go pm replaces Python pm:** Python pm is deleted from Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents, so Go pm is the only pm. pm-harness tracking now lives in Yeeef/pm with its full history.
- **Release notes and CI:** Every pm release note now comes from its CHANGELOG.md section. CI refuses a pull request or tag without one, and the slowest pull request check now runs much faster.
- **Owner-request hook:** The owner-request hook now applies one rule to every session. Agents act first, then open a sprint or task before they ask the owner.
- **Site reliability and display:** The site no longer fails to load pages while git rewrites the records. Records can show image files, and wide diagrams scroll sideways on a phone.
